title: How to Use a World Folder in Minecraft Java Edition
summary: How to download, extract, and install a custom Minecraft Java world across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items: Find the world file from the download source (e.g. via `/dn input:<download_number>` in the TheySix Discord).
Download the world to a safe location on your device.
Extract the `.zip` or `.rar` file. The extracted result should be a folder containing your world (often named after the world or map).
Open your Minecraft saves folder (see locations below).
Move the extracted world folder into the `saves/` directory. Do not rename critical files inside of it.
Close your file explorer and launch your Minecraft instance (Vanilla, Forge, Fabric, or any launcher is fine).
Open Singleplayer - your world will appear in the list. Select it and play!
